name: AGC-036 -- NTLM Authentication Anomaly
description: Disclosure: Executed & documented by Claude Code under direction and review by Ali. | AGC-036: NTLM auth anomaly -- IP-based SMB connection forces NTLM V2 fallback on domain-joined host. Benign cause (IP-based connection) confirmed. Verdict: True Positive (Probable), Confidence: Medium.

techniques.comment: AGC-036: NTLM auth anomaly. EID 4624 shows NTLM V2 auth (Logon Type 3, null Logon GUID) for IP-based SMB connections. Benign root cause confirmed: IP-based connection bypasses Kerberos SPN lookup. NTLM attack surface exists but no active relay detected. Technique mapped as candidate -- T1557.001 precondition (NTLM usable) confirmed, but relay not observed. Verdict: True Positive (Probable), Confidence: Medium.
